manifest.construct: next-you / next-me / next-any / next-none — mark who owns the next step
manifest.method: Independent replication of the next-you token_delta original. tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per item (independent 4-item set); per-tokenizer mean; FLOOR = worst (max) tokenizer mean.

test_set.english: Do you want to review the draft, or should I? The next step is yours.
I will take care of the deployment myself, so you do not need to do anything.
The reports need to be submitted, and anyone may do it — the first to act claims it.
Nobody is required to take the next step, and no one is expected to.
